workflow: Maintainer-selected local-model generation/inpainting and manual Photoshop editing.
registration: Full supplied canvases uniformly downsampled at 8x; no crop or recenter. Native texels outside unaligned cells are preserved.
alpha: Threshold 128 before/after premultiplied-alpha resampling; STP4 alpha 128 and RGB 1 carrier for opaque black.
category_states: Selected colors from supplied masters; native hue/saturation transfer for inactive states with geometry, alpha, value, black and white retained.
grips_assignment: Maintainer approved the Crossbow artwork for the Grips category and long sword grip.png for Long Grip.
